title: How Many Amazons to BEAT Stockfish?
summary: Tony has a king plus N Amazons (queen + knight) vs Fairy-Stockfish's full army, adding one Amazon each game. One amazon can't coordinate; two fall short; with three Amazons he checkmates (~10:58).
rules: Player: king + N Amazons (N starts at 1, +1 after each loss). Opponent: full standard army.

board.theme_notes: teal/mint board; amazon move dots (knight dots magenta)

custom_pieces.name: Amazon
custom_pieces.look: white queen fused with a horse head

setup: White: Ke1 + N amazons (first on d1). Black: full army.
current_impl_issues: Impl maps to kingplus t:'D' but names it 'How Many Dragons?' — the piece is the Amazon (queen+knight), not a dragon; fix name/explain.
evidence: Own srt: 00:01 'how many Amazon I need to beat fairy stockfish... queen and a knight... adding one extra Amazon each game'; 10:58 'checkmate Fairy Stockfish with three Amazon'. Frame visual_a teal board; sprites amazon.
